svg.title: Actual Linux AOSP build, Cuttlefish proof, export and teardown timeline
svg.desc: Selected actual UTC milestones on 30 October 2026 from recorded receipts: unchanged AOSP source build and baseline boot, final incremental native-r5 and image-r4 builds, passing r6 custom-image runtime proof, local evidence export verification, verified VM and disk deletion, and final teardown. Milestones are equally spaced for readability; positions and elapsed times are not benchmark results. Failed runtime attempts r1 through r5 are retained. This is not a complete transcript of every revision.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: RECORDED EXECUTION TIMELINE · 30 OCT 2026 UTC
Built on Linux. Executed in Cuttlefish. Cleaned up.
Actual receipt timestamps, shown as ordered milestones — not performance results.
Unchanged AOSP source build
Resumed r5 using existing outputs; not a clean-build duration.
Unchanged baseline boot + cleanup
Separate proof before the BoundaryLab overlay.
Final incremental native build
Final source revision; native-r5 exited successfully.
Final incremental image package
Image-r4 packaged the custom Cuttlefish image.
Custom image boot + runtime proof
R6 combined proof and guest cleanup passed.
Evidence export verified locally
Hash verification completed before deleting the server.
VM + both disks verified absent
Provider responses confirm attempt resources absent.
Attempt teardown verified
Final recorded resource lists were empty.
Five failed runtime attempts (r1–r5) are retained beside the passing r6.
Selected final milestones; intervening revisions and diagnostics remain in the evidence.
